summary: Frontend-only testing of NexusCore 3D component demo at /nexus-core-demo?particles=2500. All 5 acceptance criteria pass: page loads publicly, WebGL canvas renders, auto-rotation updates angle readout (0.0->9.9 in 1.5s), all 8 satellites present with orbiting transforms, drag rotation (15.0->114.7) works, inertia continues after release (114.7->160.1), no error boundary, no fatal console errors (only expected /api/me 502 per agent-context note).
critical_code_review_comments: NexusCore.tsx is ~615 lines - approaching the 700-line threshold; consider splitting shaders/geometry helpers/subcomponents into separate modules for maintainability.
handleRotate in demo runs every frame and mutates 8 DOM nodes directly - acceptable perf shortcut but bypasses React; document rationale.
particleCount default of 42000 is heavy for software WebGL; consider auto-detecting and lowering for non-hw accelerated contexts.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use ?particles=2500 query for automated testing (software WebGL is slow with defaults). Backend Express server intentionally not running - /api/me 502s are expected and not bugs.
